jobs.description:
About this position

As an IT/OT Security Engineer (m/f/d) in Warehouse, you ensure a secure, stable, and future-ready infrastructure combining Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) within our highly automated warehousing environment at Henkel Consumer Brands (HCB). You work at the interface of information technology, automation, and cybersecurity, playing a key role in the digital transformation of our warehousing processes and assets. Together with colleagues from Engineering, Maintenance, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and Cybersecurity, you develop solutions that sustainably optimize and secure the operation of our systems and assets.

What you'll do

- Ensure reliable operation of all IT/OT systems within the warehousing environment
- Plan and execute system updates, upgrades, and lifecycle management activities
- Implement and monitor applicable cybersecurity requirements (e.g., according to IEC 62443)
- Configure digital tools, troubleshoot issues, or escalate them when necessary to maintain the functionality of existing digital systems
- Ensure compliance with IT/OT security standards to enable secure communication and successfully deploy innovative OT solutions within the warehouse
- Design and manage projects from concept to completion, develop business cases, and implement investments in digital technologies including the management of external service providers
- Coordinate with the international Digital Transformation Team to ensure that deployed tools align with the global strategy and HCB technology standards
- Support stakeholder management and ensure transparent communication

What makes you a good fit

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Automation,  Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering)
- At least 2 years of experience with Industrial IoT and Manufacturing 4.0 in an industrial environment (experience in the consumer goods industry is an advantage)
- Experience in managing capital investment projects
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders in the adoption of new digital tools
- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken

Some perks of joining Henkel

- Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid and work from anywhere policies
- Diverse national and international growth opportunities 
- Globally wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
- Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
- Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares 
- Company Pension Plan 100% financed by Henkel
- MEGA Preventive Health Insurance 
- CareFlex Supplementary Care Insurance x
- Mobility offer: My Henkel Bike and Jobticket

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, generations and disabilities. If there are any specific accommodations or adjustments you require for the interview process or your on-site appointment, please inform us, and we'll do our best to accommodate your requests.

Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.
In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.
From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
